text: Medic two en route with a 64 year old female, chief complaint chest pressure for the last half hour.
She describes it as a heavy pressure behind the sternum, no radiation, some shortness of breath.
Allergies: she is allergic to sulfa drugs only, nothing else, confirmed with her daughter.
Vitals are heart rate 88, blood pressure 138 over 84, SpO2 97 percent, respiratory rate 18.
Twelve lead shows ST elevation in the anterior leads, this is a STEMI, acuity level one.
Administered 324 milligrams aspirin chewed at zero nine twenty one.
Patient tolerating it well, pain unchanged, repeat pressure stable.
ETA to the ED is eight minutes, nine thirty two, cath lab has been notified.
